title: Resilient 3D runtime architecture for PROFOLIO: R3F lifecycle fixes, WebGL context recovery, and WebGPU device loss
research_question: How should PROFOLIO keep its 3D experience available and avoid GPU/renderer leaks across React hide/unmount cycles, WebGL context loss, WebGPU device loss, background tabs, and mobile resource pressure?

source_quality.notes: Research uses official R3F release notes and API docs, Three.js manuals, MDN platform API docs, Khronos WebGL guidance, and the W3C WebGPU Editor's Draft. No PROFOLIO app lockfile or target-device benchmark was available.
